t: You're at the London School of Hygiene and Tropical Medicine, in Bloomsbury. It's a university college of the University of London that specialises in public and global health, epidemiology and tropical medicine, and it teaches only at postgraduate level. Sir Patrick Manson, a Scottish physician who made important discoveries in parasitology and helped found the field of tropical medicine, founded the school. The building was designed by the architect Verner Owen Rees, who worked in partnership with Frederick Milton Harvey as Rees and Harvey.
